Implementation Plan

I've written the plan below. It changes only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`, replacing the stale `decompose-run` line in place. I checked the repo first: the current file is exactly `status: ok` then `decompose-run: 41445772297`, with LF endings and one trailing newline. No test file contains the old run ID or the text `decompose-run`, so none of the other files the decomposition listed needs an edit.

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Acceptance
ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py
ACCEPTANCE: post-merge none: data-only canary edit for the E2E smoke run; no workflow behavior changes

## Functions or modules to implement
None. Rewrite `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` so it holds exactly these two lines, with LF line endings and one trailing newline:
```
status: ok
decompose-run: 43590943288
```

## Data structures affected
Only the content of the canary text file changes.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Edit only the canary file
- Chosen: Replace line 2 of `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` in place and change nothing else.
- Alternatives considered: Also edit the advisory test files the decomposition listed.
- Why: A search of `tests/*.py` finds no test that contains `41445772297` or `decompose-run`. They only refer to the canary file by its path, and the issue limits the change to this one file.

## Security considerations
There is no trust boundary, endpoint or secret involved; the change is static text in a test fixture. The only abuse case is editing other files, which the constraint not to touch `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_b.txt` or any other file rules out.

## Potential risks or edge cases
- The file must end with exactly one newline, with no trailing blank line and no CRLF endings.
- The file must keep exactly one `decompose-run:` line.
- The advisory list includes test files, but the issue's constraints say to change only the canary file, so the constraints take priority.

## Testing considerations
Check the issue's acceptance criteria:
- `head -n1` prints `status: ok`.
- `sed -n 2p` prints `decompose-run: 43590943288`.
- `wc -l` reports 2.
- `git diff --stat` shows only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.

The existing smoke contract tests don't depend on this file's content.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue defines the exact final content of a single file and forbids touching anything else. A one-line edit to the existing file delivers all of it, and there is nothing broader to build.
